# Apt packages for the Tidy Ratchet (clang-tidy-ratchet) job in lint-and-format.yml.
# One package per line; comments starting with # are ignored.

# gcc from ubuntu-toolchain-r/test: gcc moves forward with clang and meson
# rather than staying at the distro's (ADR-1230).
gcc-15
g++-15
ninja-build
nasm
jq

# libvpl-dev: the dev container that writes the baseline has it, and with it
# Meson builds test_vmaf_vpl_decode_ceiling and vmaf_vpl_core.c, two translation
# units of the baseline. The ratchet fails on a baseline translation unit this
# build does not measure.
libvpl-dev

# clang-tidy-22 from apt.llvm.org: the ubuntu-24.04 image tops out at clang 18,
# whose libstdc++ has no std::expected (ADR-0692).
clang-tidy-22
libzimg-dev
